source_text: A meta-analysis across African cohorts reported women with FGM had 1.92 times higher odds of PTSD symptoms, including flashbacks and hypervigilance, persisting into adulthood.00542-9/fulltext) [41] Depression prevalence is 1.5-2 times greater, exacerbated by sexual dissatisfaction and social stigma, with qualitative studies noting themes of shame and loss of bodily autonomy.
